main_argument_chains.claim: Sea-level rise displaces a few hundred thousand people by 2080, who can be matched to countries by a three-factor fit, while rights fall on arrival and recover under policy, and culture pays or costs by type.
support_steps: Regress sea level for six states against a five-meter cutoff
Weight cultural-loss factors by their leading components
Score acceptance, adaptation and duty, then solve the assignment
Dilute a five-indicator rights index by arrivals
Split culture into compounding gain, riot loss, and a tolerance switch
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Place whole populations where fit is highest, spend first on food, housing and medicine, market the gain-type culture, and use tolerance only to shrink losses that cannot be removed.
